title: createleadwithvehicleandcontactinfo
description: Test creating a new lead with valid contact and vehicle information via POST /api/v1/leads and verify the lead is created successfully.

title: updateleadstatuswithvaliddata
description: Test updating the status of an existing lead using PATCH /api/v1/leads/{id}/status with valid status data and verify the status is updated correctly.

title: linkvehicletolead
description: Test linking a vehicle to an existing lead via PATCH /api/v1/leads/{id}/vehicle and verify the vehicle is associated with the lead.

title: convertleadtoclient
description: Test converting a lead to a client using POST /api/v1/leads/{id}/convert with JSON body {'dni': '12345678', 'address': '123 Main St'} and verify the lead is converted and client record is created.

title: createquoteforleadorclient
description: Test creating a new quote for a lead or client via POST /api/v1/quotes and verify the quote is created with Pending status.

title: acceptquoteandtriggerdomainevents
description: Test accepting a quote using POST /api/v1/quotes/{id}/accept and verify the quote status changes to Accepted and related domain events update lead status and create client as expected.
